description: clip-path: inset() clips a solid box down to an inner rectangle. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported (only inside SVG defs).
clip-path: inset() with a round radius clips a solid box to a rounded-corner rectangle. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
clip-path: circle() clips a solid square to a centered circular disc. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
clip-path: ellipse() clips a solid rectangle to a centered ellipse with distinct x/y radii. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
clip-path: polygon() clips a solid square into a diamond via four percentage vertices. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
mask-image: linear-gradient() fades a solid fill from opaque to transparent left-to-right. CSS mask is unsupported (PDF SMask used internally for blur alpha only).
mask-image: radial-gradient() leaves a solid disc fading to transparent at the edges. CSS mask is unsupported.
mask-image: url() references a data:-URI SVG whose white circle defines the visible region. CSS mask is unsupported.

mask-image: linear-gradient(135deg) fades a solid fill diagonally from opaque (top-left) to transparent (bottom-right) via the alpha channel. CSS mask is unsupported (PDF SMask used internally for blur alpha only).
mask-image: repeating-linear-gradient() tiles opaque/transparent bands across a solid fill (repeating CSS gradient mask source). CSS mask is unsupported.
mask-image: conic-gradient() masks a solid fill to an opaque half-turn wedge fading to transparent. CSS mask is unsupported.
mask-mode: luminance uses a white->black gradient's luminance as coverage so a solid fill fades from visible (white) to masked (black). CSS mask is unsupported.
mask-image: none leaves a solid box fully opaque (initial value). CSS mask is unsupported.
-webkit-mask-image (prefixed alias) fades a solid fill top-to-bottom; the alias must behave as mask-image. CSS mask is unsupported.
clip-path: inset(0) content-box clips a bordered, padded box to its content-box reference; catches geometry-box keywords ignored as bare border-box inset().
clip-path: polygon(evenodd, ...) cuts an inner rectangular hole; catches polygon clipping that ignores the fill-rule or always uses nonzero fill.
Two mask-image layers with mask-composite:exclude punch a circular hole through a full-box mask; catches single-layer masks or ignored compositing.

feature: clip-path has no effect on layout
description: clip-path must not change layout geometry: A clipped first box keeps its original block size, so the following green bar starts below the unclipped 100px layout height. Catches wrong implementation: Layout engine shrinks the box to the clip bounds and moves the following bar upward.

description: Ancestor overflow and child clip-path must intersect: A clipped child overflows an overflow:hidden parent; visible paint is the intersection of parent rectangle and child circle. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer applies only one clip or fails to nest clipping paths.

SVG image masks in match-source mode use luminance: An SVG mask image has a red half and a white half; match-source should use luminance so red is only partially visible and white is fully visible. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation treats SVG image masks as pure alpha, making both halves equally visible.

feature: mask-mode: alpha with SVG image mask
description: mask-mode:alpha on SVG images must ignore luminance: The same red/white SVG mask is used with mask-mode:alpha; both opaque halves should be fully visible. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer always uses luminance for SVG masks, making the red half dim.

mask-composite:subtract must combine multiple mask layers: Two mask layers, a circle and a rectangle, are combined with subtract to create visible circle minus rectangle. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer keeps only the first mask layer or ignores mask-composite.

mask-composite:intersect must combine multiple mask layers: Two mask layers, a circle and a rectangle, are combined with intersect to create only circle-rectangle overlap. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer keeps only the first mask layer or ignores mask-composite.

mask-composite:add must combine multiple mask layers: Two mask layers, a circle and a rectangle, are combined with add to create union of two masks. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer keeps only the first mask layer or ignores mask-composite.

mask shorthand must expand position/size/repeat/mode/composite: The mask shorthand sets a linear mask at 20px 10px / 80px 80px no-repeat alpha. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation treats mask as only mask-image and drops geometry/mode components.

Inline SVG <mask> references must honor mask-type:alpha: A CSS box references an inline SVG <mask> whose black regions have alpha 1 and mask-type:alpha, while a transparent middle stripe masks out content. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation only loads SVG image URLs, treats black as zero luminance, or ignores transparent mask alpha.

Inline SVG <mask> default luminance must hide black regions: A CSS box references an inline SVG <mask> with a black left half and white right half; default luminance hides black and reveals white. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation treats the mask as alpha-only or ignores inline fragment masks.

mask-border must slice and apply a border-box mask: A mask-border gradient should reveal only a border ring around a solid box. Catches wrong implementation: Renderer has no mask-border fields and paints the entire box.

-webkit-mask-position alias must behave like mask-position: Only the prefixed mask-position/size/repeat properties are authored, matching common Chromium content. Catches wrong implementation: Implementation aliases -webkit-mask-image but ignores prefixed geometry longhands.
